item.title: EasySqueezy 1.0.4
item.description:
### EasySqueezy 1.0.4
- The current macOS look: on macOS 26 and later, the title bar and window buttons now match Finder and other current apps. - A little more room around the edges of the window, matching the Mac's own spacing. - Zoom and Bring All to Front in the Window menu, and Services in the app menu, like every Mac app. - The About window's credits are easier to read, and Esc closes it.
